history.summary: 999-yr (quasi-freehold) unit at Vetro, D12 (Boon Keng/Balestier), asking $799k at $964 PSF for 829 sqft (labelled 1BR but oversized — likely a 2BR or jumbo). Very low PSF vs $1,615 median, but only 12 URA txns and 1.17km from MRT.
history.rating_rationale: $964 PSF is a striking ~40% discount to median and 999-yr tenure is effectively freehold, but the 829 sqft '1BR' is misclassified (judge on real layout), the 6.16%/yr rate rests on just 12 txns (not credible), the development is small/boutique, and 1.17km to Boon Keng MRT (14-min walk) is weak. Low entry quantum and near-city D12 location are the genuine pluses; thin data and poor connectivity hold it to Neutral.

history.summary: The algo's #1-of-batch score (774) rests entirely on a mis-scraped PSF. Web-verified recent Vetro transactions are S$1,467-1,496 psf (avg ~S$1,477), not the S$964 psf in the dossier. The -47.1% 'cheap' signal and very_low_psf flag are pure data artifacts (psf_cohort_txns=0).
history.rating_rationale: Dossier shows psf S$964 and age_adj_premium -47.1% (deeply cheap), but actual 12-month resale at Vetro ran S$1,467-1,496 psf (avg ~S$1,477, e.g. S$1,496 for a 614 sqft unit in Jul 2025). A real 829 sqft unit at S$1,477 psf would be ~S$1.22M, not S$799K, so either the price/sqft pairing is wrong or the listing is stale/mis-fed. psf_cohort_txns=0 means the -30.1% cohort discount has zero real comparables behind it. The 829 sqft 'oversized 1BR' is also a label error: Vetro 1+1 units are 473-796 sqft, so 829 sqft is a 2-room. With the core value signal unverifiable and contradicted by real transactions, this fails verification.
